# Track Studio 1.2.9-rc.202611211817

## 中文

本轮只处理打包，不改音频引擎、Electron 版本与推理架构，功能与 1.2.9-rc.202611201536 一致。

- 修复 `rust_package` 被重复打包两次的问题：项目根目录与 `node_modules` 下指向同一物理目录，此前在安装包内各存一份。
- 安装包不再包含源码、开发文档、source map、构建脚本、截图、`.env` / `.npmrc`，以及历史遗留的损坏 `.git` 副本。
- Windows 产物不再包含 macOS 的 ONNX Runtime 与 `dylib`；macOS 产物不再包含 Windows 的 ONNX Runtime 与预编译二进制，universal 构建保持完整。
- 打包资源不再包含 FFmpeg 临时目录中重复的 `ffprobe.exe`。
- 新增打包产物审计：直接读取 `app.asar` 头表并与磁盘实际产物比对，本地 `build:win` 与 CI 发布流程都会在发现重复打包或错误平台文件时失败。

体积变化（本次 CI 构建实测，与 1.2.9-rc.202611201536 对比）：

| 产物 | 上一版 | 本版 | 变化 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 安装器 | 490,441,269 字节（467.72 MiB） | 328,330,598 字节（313.12 MiB） | −154.62 MiB（−33.0%） |
| macOS universal dmg | 514,206,125 字节（490.38 MiB） | 466,268,417 字节（444.67 MiB） | −45.72 MiB（−9.3%） |
| macOS universal zip | 513,429,321 字节 | 465,511,614 字节 | −45.70 MiB（−9.3%） |

本地验证构建的 Windows 安装器为 283.51 MiB，比 CI 产物小约 29.6 MiB。差异不在减重规则（两边的 `app.asar` 分别为 28.21 / 28.13 MiB，条目数相当），而在 FFmpeg：CI 每次从 BtbN 的 master 构建现场拉取并复制全部 7 个 DLL（含本地没有的 `avfilter-12` 36.4 MiB、`avdevice-63` 4.7 MiB、`swscale-10` 2.4 MiB）。

原生模块加载、FFmpeg/ffprobe、SQLite（含 SQLCipher）、ONNX Runtime、r3-stretch 与 Demucs bootstrap 已在本地 Windows 产物上逐项验证；CI 也通过了包内原生模块加载与 Demucs 资源校验。

## English

This release changes packaging only. The audio engine, Electron version and inference architecture are untouched, so behaviour matches 1.2.9-rc.202611201536.

- Fixed `rust_package` being packaged twice: the repository root and `node_modules` point at the same physical directory, and both copies previously ended up in the installer.
- The bundle no longer ships sources, developer docs, source maps, build scripts, screenshots, `.env` / `.npmrc`, or stale corrupted `.git` copies.
- The Windows build no longer includes macOS ONNX Runtime binaries or `dylib` files; the macOS build no longer includes Windows ONNX Runtime binaries or prebuilt binaries. The universal build stays complete.
- Bundled resources no longer include the duplicated `ffprobe.exe` from the FFmpeg temporary directory.
- Added a packaged-bundle audit that reads the `app.asar` header and compares it against the files on disk. Both the local `build:win` script and the CI release workflow fail when duplicated or wrong-platform files reappear.

Size change (measured on this CI build, versus 1.2.9-rc.202611201536):

| Artifact | Previous | This build | Change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Windows installer | 490,441,269 B (467.72 MiB) | 328,330,598 B (313.12 MiB) | −154.62 MiB (−33.0%) |
| macOS universal dmg | 514,206,125 B (490.38 MiB) | 466,268,417 B (444.67 MiB) | −45.72 MiB (−9.3%) |
| macOS universal zip | 513,429,321 B | 465,511,614 B | −45.70 MiB (−9.3%) |

The locally verified Windows installer was 283.51 MiB, about 29.6 MiB smaller than the CI artifact. The difference is not in the packaging rules (both builds produce a comparable `app.asar`: 28.21 vs 28.13 MiB) but in FFmpeg: CI downloads the BtbN master build and copies all seven DLLs, including `avfilter-12` (36.4 MiB), `avdevice-63` (4.7 MiB) and `swscale-10` (2.4 MiB), which the local build does not ship.

Native module loading, FFmpeg/ffprobe, SQLite (including SQLCipher), ONNX Runtime, r3-stretch and the Demucs bootstrap were each verified against the local Windows build output; CI additionally passed the packaged native module load and the Demucs resource checks.
